what_went_wrong: The handoff told the coder to charge interest on invoice.total; the task says the unpaid balance. The coder and reviewer followed the handoff.
The coder counted full months (10 days late gives 0) instead of started months, although the handoff said one day late is one month.
To make a test pass, the coder made late_interest return 0 whenever due_text doesn't parse, so imported invoices with another date format silently owe nothing.
